items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Sy is doing in now, I think. ... Sy can get away with it because he got a lot of other stuff with it. ... Sy would do a good job with it, but he ain't got a big enough band.

ctx.x: Well, the way they did it, it wasn't corny, was it?
Well, Sy is doing in now, I think.
